title: search_urls reads only Learn's results list, asks hosts whose answer it cannot read, and memoizes by query, so GitHub, arXiv and PyPI answers are no answer and a second provider reuses the first's hits
goal: factdiff.search_urls reads each provider's 200 answer by its known shape (provider.search_shape: items for GitHub, Atom XML for arXiv) and treats only an answer outside that shape as no result list, so a 200 with an empty list of the provider's shape stays an answer with no hits; it asks a provider's search_api only for a row whose shape it reads, so a row with no known shape costs no request; and its search memo is keyed by the expanded request, not the query, so each provider's search is asked once and its own outcome is used

run: import sys; sys.path.insert(0,'_tools'); import factdiff as f, provider as p; p.request=lambda u, **k: {'status':200,'body':'{"total_count":0,"items":[]}','headers':{}}; f.search_urls('Get-Thing returns a value', None, {'search_api':'https://api.github.com/search/code?q={q}&per_page=10'}, 'https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/x.md'); sys.exit(1 if [r for r in f._unanswered if 'api.github.com' in r] else 0)

import sys,json;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import factdiff as f,provider as p;seen=[];body=json.dumps({'total_count':1,'items':[{'html_url':'https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/y.md','path':'y.md','repository':{'full_name':'o/r'}}]});p.request=lambda u,**k:seen.append(u) or {'status':200,'body':body,'headers':{}};fact='Get-Thing returns a value';a=f.search_urls(fact,None,{'search_api':'https://api.github.com/search/code?q={q}&per_page=10'},'https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/x.md');b=f.search_urls(fact,None,{'search_api':'https://api.github.com/search/repositories?q={q}&per_page=10'},'https://github.com/o/r');c=f.search_urls(fact,None,{'search_api':'https://unknown.example.com/s?q={q}'},'https://unknown.example.com/x');ok=a==['https://github.com/o/r/blob/main/y.md'] and len(seen)==2 and any('repositories' in u for u in seen) and not any('unknown' in u for u in seen) and not f._unanswered;print(a,b,c,seen,f._unanswered);sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
